dillonl07: On the way to R-R8, Gustav Dillonl tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.

Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Gustav Dillonl shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gustav Dillonl. Gustav Dillonl read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
evan.little.14: Silas "Brick" Little left twin brothers too young to enlist behind in Belmonte and came up the line with a child's drawing of a horse. The men noticed at once that he never sits with his back to the parapet. Silas "Brick" Little's transfer to the role of sniper was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

Blackwater Canal is lost. Silas "Brick" Little heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race. Mail came up the line with a letter for Silas "Brick" Little. Silas "Brick" Little read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
frankly_franz: Rafael "Owl" Franz came up with a draft of replacements on Day 4. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

Asked what he wanted after the war, Rafael "Owl" Franz said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on. A letter from home reached Rafael "Owl" Franz before dusk. Rafael "Owl" Franz read it twice and slept a little easier.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Rafael "Owl" Franz tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at R-F4 is up. Rafael "Owl" Franz raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F4. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp of the Hegemony (@malakaicripps). The Hegemony hold Hill 304 now, and they can see straight into R-F4. Rafael "Owl" Franz has learned to walk bent double.
Rafael "Owl" Franz's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
On a quiet night Rafael "Owl" Franz (Concord) and Jonas Nicopaoletto (Hegemony) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there.

Rafael "Owl" Franz hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back. A letter from home reached Rafael "Owl" Franz before dusk. Rafael "Owl" Franz read it twice and slept a little easier. The signallers took Rafael "Owl" Franz in on a busy morning in R-F4. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.

A note came over the wire at Lantern Hill, wrapped around a stone: 'Stop singing, Concord. Signed, Konrad Danielmcmena.' Rafael "Owl" Franz sang louder. A letter from home reached Rafael "Owl" Franz before dusk. Rafael "Owl" Franz read it twice and slept a little easier.

At R-F4 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Rafael "Owl" Franz turned around and took a shovel blow. Valentin "Smokes" Lilmaggs of the Hegemony was already gone. Raider: Valentin "Smokes" Lilmaggs of the Hegemony (@lilmaggs21). Rafael "Owl" Franz went in with a pistol and a trench club. In the Hegemony trench Oskar "Mud" Pyyro put up a fight, but not for long. (@pyyro.2030) The raid was quick, the way back was not. Rafael "Owl" Franz snagged on the wire and took a bullet before the others pulled Rafael "Owl" Franz free. Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Rafael "Owl" Franz stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores. A letter from home reached Rafael "Owl" Franz before dusk. Rafael "Owl" Franz read it twice and slept a little easier.
jake_81590: Nobody asked Leopold "Tin" Jake why he came. Nobody in Q-F16 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.

The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In Q-F16, Leopold "Tin" Jake listened to three explanations and trusted none of them. Mail came up the line with a letter for Leopold "Tin" Jake. Leopold "Tin" Jake read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
kebapien22: The sergeant gave Silas Kebapien a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 9 or any other.
News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Silas Kebapien during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
mrcakerson: Hugo Mrcakerson walked into S-S12 on Day 5 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
Hugo Mrcakerson hates silence more than shelling. Today, under fire at Saint-Ash crossroads, that habit was the only steady thing in S-S12.
Hugo Mrcakerson started keeping a diary in the back of a field service book. First entry: "Still here."
Hugo Mrcakerson and Tobias Deadeyesimul divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.
Hugo Mrcakerson kept watch so that Ulrich Nothing could sleep. Then Ulrich kept watch so that Hugo could. Neither slept.

A round went through the rim of Hugo Mrcakerson's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Gustav Mini of the Concord (@mini_i.r.s). Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Hugo Mrcakerson could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
nilsiiboy12: The old hands of S-C4 have been here since Day 1. Yann Nilsiiboy has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.

Yann Nilsiiboy was hit in the forearm at S-C4. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Karel Lynallwarrio of the Concord (@lynallwarrior51). On Day 10, Blackwater Canal passed to the Hegemony. Yann Nilsiiboy wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
proto_guyy: In Lindenbruck, Oskar "Smokes" Guyy was a medical student. In R-F14, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a medical student again.
Oskar "Smokes" Guyy answered the first call, number 69 on the rolls. Somebody chalked the number on his helmet. It has not washed off yet.
Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Oskar "Smokes" Guyy watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Oskar "Smokes" Guyy came off watch and could not say whether the last hour had felt long or short. He remembered every move in one patch of wire.
The rain did not stop once. Oskar "Smokes" Guyy slept standing up, wedged against the wall of R-F14, and dreamt of dry socks.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Oskar "Smokes" Guyy tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at R-F14 is up. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Hill 304. Oskar "Smokes" Guyy read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Oskar "Smokes" Guyy washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation.
The corporal found out Oskar "Smokes" Guyy used to be a medical student. Oskar "Smokes" Guyy has been doing two jobs ever since.

Machine-gun fire swept R-F14. Oskar "Smokes" Guyy took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Jakub Virajvirxgil of the Hegemony (@virajvirxgill13). Oskar "Smokes" Guyy was killed on watch at R-F14. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Jakub Virajvirxgil of the Hegemony (@virajvirxgill13).

Florian "Doc" Guyy put a tin whistle beside the bunk. Someone who had known Oskar "Smokes" Guyy helped clear the shelf without saying why. Florian "Doc" Guyy is one of the first hundred to answer the call. He wears the ribbon of the First Wave.

Florian "Doc" Guyy felt a hard tug at his hip at R-F14. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Wendel "Mole" Freddie of the Hegemony (@0__freddie__0). Florian "Doc" Guyy was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Henrik Sedlomancz was badly wounded.

Florian "Doc" Guyy's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it. News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached R-F14 with the rations. Florian "Doc" Guyy ate while listening to the revised orders.
rei0_shi4: The new rifleman is Severin "Lucky" Shi, once a coal miner from Saint-Lune. The corporal asked if a coal miner was any use in a trench. Severin "Lucky" Shi said he would find out.
The Concord won Verdel Ridge. In R-F8, Severin "Lucky" Shi listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
The salvo walked along R-F8 and caught Severin "Lucky" Shi in the open. Two men carried him back between salvos.
Severin "Lucky" Shi spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice.

No bed for Severin "Lucky" Shi yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up. On Day 6, Hill 304 passed to the Hegemony. Severin "Lucky" Shi wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Every bed was taken and every medic was busy. Severin "Lucky" Shi died waiting. The men at R-F8 have not stopped talking about it.
The papers say Benedikt Shi. The sergeant says he has his cousin's eyes. Severin "Lucky" Shi's eyes. Nobody in R-F8 argues.

Benedikt Shi fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Gustav "Mud" Raptor, gravely wounded. Nobody nearby said anything. A letter from home reached Benedikt Shi before dusk. Benedikt Shi read it twice and slept a little easier.

Fog hid the far end of R-F8. Benedikt Shi kept counting the turns so as not to walk past the dugout. A letter from home reached Benedikt Shi before dusk. Benedikt Shi read it twice and slept a little easier.

Benedikt Shi waited for someone in the enemy trench to lift a pair of field glasses. Yann Spring did, and was grazed. A letter from home reached Benedikt Shi before dusk. Benedikt Shi read it twice and slept a little easier.
Benedikt Shi was on watch at R-F8 when the night raid hit. The men found Benedikt Shi at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Gideon "Mole" Deale of the Concord (@richard.deale).
Casimir Shi took the same post at R-F8 where Benedikt Shi stood. He found his cousin's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
santiago.g.adauto: Day 5. The corporal put Karel Adauto beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.

Karel Adauto's hands still remember being a tram conductor's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world. A letter from home reached Karel Adauto before dusk. Karel Adauto read it twice and slept a little easier. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Hill 304. Karel Adauto read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Karel Adauto started keeping a diary in the back of a field service book. First entry: "Still here." A letter from home reached Karel Adauto before dusk. Karel Adauto read it twice and slept a little easier.
Karel Adauto and Bastian Christianbar sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.

Bastian Christianbar gave Karel Adauto the last match in the trench. Karel used it to light a candle so that Bastian could finish a letter. A letter from home reached Karel Adauto before dusk. Karel Adauto read it twice and slept a little easier.

Karel Adauto's diary, day nine: "Still here. Soup again. A rat called the Major. Nothing else worth writing, which is the point." A letter from home reached Karel Adauto before dusk. Karel Adauto read it twice and slept a little easier.

Night raid. Karel Adauto crossed no man's land, saw the enemy sentry too late to reach, and came back without a scratch. Next time, says Karel Adauto. The Hegemony raiders were in and out in two minutes. At S-F1 they left Karel Adauto behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Bastian Enjoyer of the Hegemony (@autism_enjoyer_08).
Florian Adauto joined S-F1 under the shadow of Karel Adauto's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
shooter.conqueror_napoleon: Leopold "Crow" Napoleon joined the replacements on Day 9. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Leopold "Crow" Napoleon watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
st0nk_boy: The old hands of S-S16 have been here since Day 1. Severin "Crow" Boy has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.

Severin "Crow" Boy fed a new belt into the gun and laid it on the enemy path at S-S16. Before dawn Arno Nathangrundm walked into it, badly wounded. On Day 10, Blackwater Canal passed to the Hegemony. Severin "Crow" Boy wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
state_approved_idiot: Roland "Ghost" Idiot told the sergeant he was a tailor. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.
A rat stole Roland "Ghost" Idiot's cheese ration while he watched. He let it. The rat looked hungrier.
Victory at Blackwater Canal. Roland "Ghost" Idiot let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
zzkaake: At the depot, Karel Zzkaake had practised answering to his name. At R-R11, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In R-R11, Karel Zzkaake listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
